name: atelier-ranger
intent: A human-proportioned painterly ranger for a coastal playable scene; replace primitive-based characters after review.
textureBudget: vertex-painted surfaces; optional authored base colour atlas later
licensing: Original locally authored geometry and animation in this project. No third-party models or samples.
artDirection: Adult proportions, angular cheek and jaw planes, indigo and teal cloth with directional painted variation, warm leather and restrained ochre highlights. Layered tunic, cloak and boots. Avoid spherical joint toys, oversized heads and recycled low-poly geometry.
